record: Joined Rep. Gottheimer in introducing the No DeepSeek on Government Devices Act.
With Rep. Gottheimer, wrote to US governors urging them to ban DeepSeek from state government devices.
Co-introduced the Advanced AI Security Readiness Act (NSA AI security playbook against foreign adversaries).
Joined colleagues in introducing the Chip Security Act (location verification for advanced AI chips to stop smuggling to China).
grade_reason: His AI statements found are all from 2025 and about defending American AI from China (chip smuggling, an NSA security playbook, DeepSeek bans), with no acknowledgment of catastrophic risk; nothing about AI from him in 2026 was found.
notes: All six required web searches ran this time, plus one on Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act cosponsors (seven in total); the search is complete. None of the searches found any statement by him on superintelligence, extinction, loss of control, a pause or slowdown, an AI agreement with China, or AI safety. Sources for the House Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act (H.R. 10538, led by Rep. Casar) list only Democratic cosponsors (fastdemocracy names Hoyle, Lynch, Tonko; Forkast says Ocasio-Cortez and nine other Democrats); he is not shown as a cosponsor. No House letter on AI risk led by him was found. A Fox News article of 2025-06-12 (https://www.foxnews.com/politics/house-bipartisan-bill-directs-nsa-create-ai-security-playbook-amid-chinese-tech-race) quotes him at length on the AI race with China (e.g. it will be critical to future warfare capabilities and cybersecurity); read at source, all competition with China, so D and not added as a separate statement. The record entries for the February and March 2025 DeepSeek actions are from search result titles; those pages were not opened. Axios Pro (2025-06-17, 'LaHood on AI, China and export controls') is paywalled and was not read. From the earlier attempt: his official press release list pages 1 to 7 (November 2026 back to April 2025) were read directly and only the two releases quoted mention AI in that span; the 6/10/25 list entry carried the AI bill title with an Alzheimer's path, apparently a listing glitch, not used.
